message: NO TRADE — complete fresh 18-symbol Dukascopy H1 scan GDESK-2026-09-17T05-387f89ab66 produced no genuinely qualified setup. AUDUSD and NZDUSD show a four-bar rebound but are retracing the prior sharp displacement rather than presenting a clean confirmed breakout. USDJPY and JPY crosses are consolidating after the prior volatility impulse. XAUUSD remains exceptionally volatile and directionally unstable after the large displacement and rebound. No candidate currently combines a fresh trigger, efficient invalidation, acceptable spread/volatility and sufficiently independent exposure to justify 0.25%-0.5% risk.
